name: Weekly Top-3 Report
description: Compile the weekly Top-3 artists/tracks report every Sunday.

then.prompt: Compile the MainStay TV Weekly Top-3 report. Steps: 1) Query the analytics table for all posts from the past 7 days. 2) Calculate engagement score per artist: (views * 1) + (likes * 2) + (shares * 3) + (comments * 2) + (follows_gained * 5). 3) Rank artists/tracks by total engagement score. 4) Generate a markdown report saved to agent/reports/week-<YYYY-WW>.md with: week dates, Top-3 ranked artists with their tracks and scores, standout content formats, and a recommendation for next week's focus. 5) Insert the top 3 into the weekly_reports table. 6) Print the report.
